heading: Мутаційний верстат
title: Mutation workbench
note: New with the MVP (m8 §4). The workbench is the machine's own screen (the engineer, 2026-10-21/22; the target page pages/suit-final, frames 9a to 9c): this scene is the root of a SubViewport (960 x 540, the target's 640 x 360 x 1.5, with the game's Theme) whose ViewportTexture the machine's screen mesh shows, so whoever stands there sees the same screen. It is no overlay: the mouse stays captured, the player's own HUD (s7) stays over the world, and the player works the screen with the crosshair: the game raycasts the screen mesh and pushes the hit point into the SubViewport as mouse motion and Interact as a left click (SubViewport.push_input), so the control under the crosshair hovers; how the input reaches it is the game's choice. The page draws the 960 x 540 canvas alone, centred in the frame. The flow: walk up and start it, choose a mutation, step into the capsule beside the machine, and it mutates you. Points buy three positive mutations; the points show only here. Walking away leaves the screen to the next player (no Close).

states.label: Чекає
states.note: Nobody uses the machine: its name and Start. Interact on Start starts it.

states.label: Вибір
states.note: 7 points: Quick feet (4) and Spring legs (3) can be bought, Thick skin (9) cannot. The crosshair is on Spring legs' button, so it hovers.

states.label: У машині
states.note: Spring legs chosen: the screen names it and fills its ten pips while the player stands in the capsule (seen from inside on the target page); when they are full the mutation is done and the screen goes back to idle.

nodes.name: Screen
nodes.note: In the game: the SubViewport's root, anchors full_rect in the 960 x 540 viewport (the page centres it in the frame). ToyPanelDialog is the pack's machine screen frame: the plain tile, 42 px inside.

children.name: Start
children.note: workbench.start («Почати», the engineer's word, 2026-10-22): Interact with the crosshair on it opens the choice (choose) for this player. At least 288 wide (the target's large button), an easy mark for the crosshair (agent).

children.name: Balance
children.note: The player's points: the only place they show (decided 2026-10-20: no points on the HUD). The screen shows the points of the player using it; updates live.

children.name: Points
children.note: The points, a number from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Cards
children.note: The three MVP mutations (m8 §4: run faster, jump higher, more HP), equal widths, 24 px apart (the target's 14 x 1.5 = 21, the nearest step). Open: their names, prices, whether one can be bought twice, whether a mutation lasts the match or ends at death, whether the HUD shows the ones you have.

children.name: Fast
children.note: One mutation (content data): its name, what it does, its price in points and the buy button. The card looks the same whether it can be bought or not; only its button changes (Mutate: enabled; disabled with workbench.short when the points are short). There is no "already have" state: whether a mutation can be bought twice is open.

children.name: Effect
children.note: Takes the card's free height, so the price and the button sit at the bottom.

children.name: Cost
children.note: The price, tr_n("unit.points", "unit.points", price) with {count} = the price (content data; the prices are placeholders, open).

children.name: Buy
children.note: Spends the price, and the screen asks the player into the capsule (step); disabled when the points are short.

children.name: Buy
children.note: Under the crosshair: hovered (the pushed mouse motion).

children.name: Buy
children.note: Not enough points: disabled, with workbench.short, {count} = price - balance.

children.name: Chosen
children.note: The chosen mutation's name (content data) in the kicker (the game writes it in capitals).

children.name: StepIn
children.note: workbench.step_in («Стань у машину», the engineer's word, 2026-10-22): the capsule beside the machine; the pips fill only while the player stands in it.

children.name: Pips
children.note: The mutation's progress as ten pips (the suit's ToyPip and ToyPipHealth), filling while the player stands in the capsule; 6 of 10 here.
